summary: ATI Inc. filed an 8-K on June 3, 2026, announcing the pricing of a $450 million public offering of 5.875% Senior Notes due 2033. The net proceeds, expected to be approximately $350 million, will be used to redeem all outstanding 5.875% Senior Notes due 2027, with any remainder for general corporate purposes. The offering is an ordinary debt refinancing under an effective shelf registration statement, with Goldman Sachs and J.P. Morgan as joint book-running managers. No premium, stake, or special-situation mechanics apply. This is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
